fields.description: The date the hosting and support package runs out. Leave blank to switch the whole feature off.
fields.label: Expiry Date

fields.description: How many days before expiry the countdown starts appearing at login.
fields.label: Start Reminding (Days Before Expiry)

fields.description: After the expiry date passes, stop every user except the Administrator at login.
fields.label: Restrict Access After Expiry

fields.options: Safety release. If a wrong date ever locks the client out, add "prymage_subscription_bypass": 1 to site_config.json and run bench --site <site> clear-cache. Login is then allowed for everyone again regardless of the expiry date. The Administrator account is never locked out.

fields.default: Your ERPNext Hosting and Support Package will expire in {days} days (Expiry Date: {date}). Don't hesitate to get in touch with your ERPNext Service Providers.
fields.description: Shown from the reminder threshold onwards. Placeholders: {days}, {date}, {provider}.
fields.label: Reminder Message

fields.default: Your ERPNext Hosting and Support Package expired on {date}. Don't hesitate to get in touch with your service provider to renew your Package to continue enjoying the services.
fields.description: Shown once the expiry date has passed. Placeholders: {days}, {date}, {provider}.
fields.label: Expired Message
